description: This file contains the implementation of the MeetingReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve meeting data from a database in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to fetch specific meetings, meetings by entity, by calendar type, and the last meeting, utilizing JDBC template queries with custom mapping.

classes.name: MeetingReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for the MeetingReadPlatformService interface, providing data retrieval methods related to meetings.

classes.name: MeetingDataMapper
classes.description: An internal static class implementing RowMapper to convert database result rows into MeetingData objects.

methods.name: retrieveMeeting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific meeting's data based on meeting ID, entity ID, and entity type ID.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntity
methods.description: Fetches a collection of meetings associated with a specific entity, optionally limited in number.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntityByCalendarType
methods.description: Retrieves meetings for an entity filtered by specific calendar types.

methods.name: retrieveLastMeeting
methods.description: Fetches the most recent meeting for a given calendar instance.
